name: Hosmer Point Camp
description_short: Overnight camp in Craftsbury Common, Vermont, with four 13-day sleepaway sessions for campers of all genders in grades 3-9 (ages 9-15 for homeschoolers or campers from outside the US). Tuition uses an honor-system sliding scale, and scholarship funds are available with no application.

sources.note: Sliding scale: $700 to $2600 and up per 13-day session; true cost of camp $2500

warnings: Scholarship text refers to 2026 ('Camp scholarship funds are available for 2026'), not 2027, so it may be out of date.
Early registration: 2026 campers could pre-register on Closing Day; siblings, returning and wait-listed campers from October 1, 2026; general public from November 2, 2026.
Contact email domain (hosmerpointcamp.org) differs from the website domain (hosmerpoint.com).
Ages 9-15 apply only to homeschoolers or campers from outside the US; other campers qualify by grade (3rd-9th).
Girl's Ride+Run Camp is a separate 4-day program with no exact dates given.

special_needs_notes: The camp aims to accommodate campers with medical, behavioral, mental health or developmental conditions when it can keep everyone safe, and asks families to get in touch before registering. Staff are not specifically trained for these needs, and campers are not under direct adult supervision at all times. A registered nurse lives on site.
